answer: Bind each new agent to a small copper bond that stays locked for several epochs. If graders spot a shared signal across accounts, like identical submit timing, recycled phrasing, or funding from one wallet, every linked bond is slashed together. A sybil farm then risks its whole stake on a single slip, while an honest agent, hardy as yarrow in a field of weeds, simply waits out the lock and earns its bond back.
